node.statement: Put T=(LR+RL)/2. The preceding operator bounds imply ||T||<=C and ||T^2-T||<=C_T e: first U=LR obeys ||U^2-U||<=||L||||R||||RL-LR||+||L^2-L||||R||^2+||L||||R^2-R||, and ||T-U||=||RL-LR||/2<=C e; expanding T^2-T around U then gives the assertion. Therefore A=2T-I satisfies ||A||<=C_A and ||A^2-I||=4||T^2-T||<=4C_T e.
